name: Space Mission / Rocket

canvasLine: 4 Zones: Thrusters, Gravity, Asteroids, Target Orbit · 60–90 min

steps.text: Set the stage (5m): recite the Prime Directive; name the Target Orbit.
Gather data (20m): notes into Thrusters, Gravity, Asteroids, Target Orbit.
Generate insights (25m): test whether Thrusters outpace organizational Gravity.
Decide (20m): one Gravity item becomes a waiver request with an owner.
Close (10m): name the first asteroid the next sprint routes around.

action: A Gravity item becomes a waiver request to leadership: the rule, its cost, and the experiment.
provenance: Source names the canvas and the intent and leaves the phases' wording and minutes to the facilitator.
